explanation: Second normal form requires that no nonkey attribute depend on only part of a composite key. EmployeeName depends on EmployeeID alone, and ProjectName depends on ProjectID alone, so each should be separated into its own table.

options.text: Keep one table, but add indexes on EmployeeID and ProjectID
Move EmployeeName to an Employee table and ProjectName to a Project table
Add a computed column that concatenates EmployeeID and ProjectID
Rename the primary key columns so they are more descriptive

prompt: A company stores project work in a table with primary key (EmployeeID, ProjectID). The table also includes EmployeeName and ProjectName. Which change would best help move this table into second normal form?

source.title: Normalization and other Data Modeling Methods
